newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean unemployment rises to 5.8 percent in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Chilean unemployment rises to 5.8 percent in Q1.

text.p: Unemployment in Chile rose sharply in the first quarter of this year to 5.8 percent from 5.4 percent in the December-to-February quarter, the National Statistics Institute reported.

The figure, though down from 6.6 percent in the first quarter of 1996, was the latest sign of economic slowdown in Chile in the first months of this year compared to late 1996, accompanied by declines in industrial production.
The country's highest jobless rates were in the southern Eighth Region, where it reached 7.1 percent in the first quarter of the year, and 6.9 percent in metropolitan Santiago.

Unemployment fell or was unchanged in all regions of the country compared to the first quarter of last year, except in Santiago where it rose to 6.9 percent from 6.3 percent, said the institute. (( -- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom +56-2-699-5595 x211))
